name: schemaemitter-temp-tables-declare
body: Declare treats every CreateTableStatement as a declaring statement, so a top-level CREATE TABLE #temp or ##temp is emitted as a table struct under the file's default schema, as requirements.requirement.sql-declaring-statements states (a CREATE statement declares any object other than a view, procedure, function or trigger). Upgrade with a leading-# check in Declare if temporary tables are to declare nothing.
